{
  "sop_id": "SOP-016",
  "title": "Employee Expense Claim Approval",
  "steps": [
    {"step_id": "S1", "name": "Create ticket and assign to self", "role": "Executor", "type": "intake"},
    {"step_id": "S2", "name": "Check policy limits", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S3", "name": "Match receipts", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S4", "name": "Compute reimbursable amount and submit", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "A1", "name": "Incharge approval", "role": "Incharge", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "R1", "name": "Rework on rejection", "role": "Executor", "type": "rework"}
  ],
  "approvals": [
    {"stage": "Incharge", "condition": "always", "evidence": "The Incharge approves or rejects with a reason code."},
    {"stage": "Lead", "condition": "exceptions only", "evidence": "A (exceptions only)"}
  ],
  "dependencies": [],
  "rework_reasons": [
    "Amount mismatch",
    "Wrong quantity",
    "Incorrect category",
    "Required document missing"
  ],
  "first_pass_yield_target": 0.95
}
